name: Terry Bogard
source:
A PE teacher who recently transferred to the protagonist's high school.
The coach of the basketball club.
He quickly became a reliable teacher that is adored by his students.
He lives together with Rock and acts as his guardian. He's rather protective of him.
He's old friends with Ryou who instructs at the local dojo.
